tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what Alicia or digitalgarden.si has written about a subject (for example Houdini, Three.js, WebGPU, glTF/USD, Gaussian splats, AI coding agents, or the garden itself). Ranks published notes by keyword match on title, topics, summary and full text, in English and Chinese,

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Use this to read the full text of one published note when you already know its slug or its digitalgarden.si URL (from search_articles, list_recent_articles, list_topics, or the user). Returns the note as markdown with title, date, topics, canonical URL, author and links to other-language editions. A

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Use this to see which subjects the garden's published notes cover, for example when the user asks what Alicia writes about or before filtering search_articles by topic. Returns every topic with its article count, languages, and the titles and URLs of its notes. Takes no required input. Do not use it

tools.name: list_recent_articles
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for Alicia's latest, newest or recent notes, or wants to browse without a specific subject.
